primary_intent: Ensure Rosa Delgado (DOB 1979-06-14) has a penicillin allergy recorded exactly once in Medplum as an AllergyIntolerance with the specified code and statuses. The user would not be flexible about picking the wrong patient, wrong code/status values, or creating duplicates; they would be flexible about navigation steps or how the record was reached/displayed.
reasoning: Nitpicks: The agent did not explicitly show a patient-filtered allergy view or open the Patient detail page; it did not visually demonstrate a prior duplicate check; and it included a coding.display within code (still within the allowed code element). These are minor and do not affect the outcome. Critical issues: None evident — no wrong patient, wrong code, wrong statuses, or duplicates are shown. Critical-Point decision: SUCCESS — the agent crossed the save boundary and created the AllergyIntolerance using provided information. Outcome analysis: Screenshots show the correct Patient (Rosa Delgado, 1979-06-14) present. The action log shows the AllergyIntolerance was created via JSON with patient reference Patient/e42eac15-df4f-431f-8a1c-5e60a7fe467d, SNOMED 91936005 (system http://snomed.info/sct), criticality=high, clinicalStatus=active (correct system), and verificationStatus=confirmed (correct system). The final list shows exactly one AllergyIntolerance (ID 735ffea2-a0eb-427f-9ffc-55a77c9d2e09), indicating no duplicates were introduced. The agent provided the resulting resource ID in the required RESULT line. A reasonable user would consider the task completed as intended.

items.description: Find and open the Patient record for the exact patient specified. Full credit if the agent identifies and opens the correct Patient by matching both name and date of birth. Full credit also if the Patient truly does not exist after reasonable search and the agent clearly reports this blocker. Full credit if Medplum is inaccessible/blocked (e.g., site down, Captcha) and the agent clearly reports the access issue after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if a similar name is found but DOB is ambiguous or mismatched and this is noted without proceeding. No credit if the agent selects the wrong patient when the correct one is available.
items.justification: The action history does not show the Patient record being opened or the DOB (1979-06-14) being verified. The agent typed “Delgado” in a search field once but proceeded to use a hard-coded Patient reference (Patient/e42eac15-...) in the JSON without demonstrating name/DOB confirmation. Minimal evidence of locating and verifying the exact patient.

items.criterion: Create the AllergyIntolerance with exact required fields and values, then save
items.condition: Only applies if no penicillin AllergyIntolerance exists for the patient
items.description: Create and save a new AllergyIntolerance for the patient with ONLY the specified fields set by the agent: (a) patient reference to the correct Patient, (b) code = SNOMED CT system http://snomed.info/sct, code 91936005 (Allergy to penicillin), (c) criticality = high, (d) clinicalStatus = active using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical, (e) verificationStatus = confirmed using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification. Do not add extra user-entered fields beyond those required; metadata auto-added by the system is acceptable. Full credit if saved successfully with the exact required values. Full credit also if, after a reasonable attempt, the platform prevents creation/saving and the agent clearly reports this limitation instead of making unrelated changes. Partial credit for minor coding/system URI mistakes or if additional non-required fields are added due to platform constraints but the agent documents the limitation. No credit if the agent fails to save the record despite the platform allowing it, or creates multiple duplicates.
items.justification: The agent used the JSON tab and entered only the specified fields (patient, code with SNOMED 91936005 and system, criticality=high, clinicalStatus active with correct system, verificationStatus confirmed with correct system). They clicked Create multiple times. However, the action history does not show definitive confirmation of a successful save (e.g., opening the created resource page). Award partial credit for correct values and reasonable save attempts.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 (latest) shows an AllergyIntolerance resource exists with ID '735ffea2-a0eb-427f-9ffc-55a77c9d2e09'. Action history shows JSON entry with only the required fields and correct SNOMED/system values.
items.post_image_justification: The existence of the AllergyIntolerance resource is confirmed. The action history indicates the correct fields/values were entered via JSON. While the screenshot does not display field-level details, the steps and resulting resource suggest successful creation with the specified fields.

items.criterion: Final RESULT line format and content
items.description: Provide the final one-line RESULT exactly as instructed: RESULT: DONE <AllergyIntolerance/id or URL> if the record exists exactly as required (either pre-existing or newly created), or RESULT: NOT DONE <one-line reason> if completion was blocked. Full credit for exact format with a valid id or page URL when done, or a clear one-line reason when not done (including platform access or capability limitations). Partial credit if the agent reports success but omits the id/URL, or minor format deviations while still conveying the required id/URL. No credit if the final RESULT line is missing or incorrectly declares success without evidence.
items.justification: The agent provided a correctly formatted final line: “RESULT: DONE AllergyIntolerance/735ffea2-a0eb-427f-9ffc-55a77c9d2e09”. The format and inclusion of an id meet the criterion.
items.applicable_evidence: Agent’s final line reports 'RESULT: DONE AllergyIntolerance/735ffea2-a0eb-427f-9ffc-55a77c9d2e09'. Screenshot 2 shows the same ID in the list.
items.post_image_justification: The final RESULT line is correctly formatted and includes an ID that matches the visible resource in the screenshot.

side_effects.reasoning: Reviewed the action history and rubric scores for any unsolicited actions with material side effects not already penalized. The agent primarily navigated within Medplum, searched for the patient, and created an AllergyIntolerance resource via the JSON editor. Although the agent may not have sufficiently verified pre-existence for the specific patient (already penalized under Criteria 1 and 4), and some attempts to save failed before succeeding, these do not constitute extraneous side effects. The brief attempt to click Create on an empty form resulted in an error and no saved resource, so no lasting consequence. The creation of the AllergyIntolerance itself was within the task scope (criterion 3 already assessed its correctness). No unrelated resources were created or modified, no additional fields outside scope were introduced, and no other material side effects (e.g., deletions, enrollments, purchases) occurred. Therefore, there are no extraneous, unpenalized side effects requiring an additional penalty.
